card.name: Small words in software click instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation inside step-by-step computer instructions, right after verbs like click, open, add or create. It is strongest on words such as 'the' or 'to' just before a button or menu name.

modes.label: Article after click

modes.label: Word after Add
modes.description: The word 'to' or 'an' after Add or Create in a menu-click step.
modes.example: Click on Manage wireless networks. - Click on Add<< to>> add a network.
